title: ScSpecTypeUdt
description:
ScSpecTypeUdt is an XDR Struct defined as:

```text struct SCSpecTypeUDT { string name<SC_SPEC_TYPE_NAME_LIMIT>; }; ```

StringM<1024>.description: XDR string of at most 1024 bytes. Backslashes and bytes outside printable ASCII are escaped (for example as \xNN), so the JSON string can be longer than 1024 characters.
